ex: Enough handheld radios for the work.
11.5.fg: Sapat na handheld radios para sa operations.
fc: Sapat na UHF/VHF portable radios + charged batteries
fx: Sapat na handheld radios para sa trabaho.

ex: SARTs in good condition and tested.
fc: Battery expiry; monthly test log

11.7.eg: GMDSS VHF portables (survival craft) with sealed batteries in date.
ex: GMDSS VHF portables in good condition and charged.
11.7.fg: GMDSS VHF portables (survival craft) na may sealed batteries na hindi expired.
fc: Primary lithium batteries naka-seal at hindi expired; gumagana ang radios
fx: Maayos at charged ang GMDSS VHF portables.

11.8.eg: AIS: static/voyage data correct (draft, destination, ETA, nav status), annual test.
ex: Correct static, dynamic and voyage data in the AIS, and annual test.
11.8.fg: AIS: tama ang static/voyage data (draft, destination, ETA, nav status), annual test.
fc: I-check ang AIS display: tamang draft, destination, ETA, nav status, bilang ng crew
May annual AIS test report sa barko
fx: Tama ang static, dynamic at voyage data sa AIS, at may annual test.
ff: Mali ang AIS voyage data (draft, destination, nav status)

11.9.fg: Shore-Based Maintenance agreement para sa GMDSS.
fc: Kopya ng SBM contract

12.1.eg: Gangway watch: visitor log, ID check, present at all times.
ex: Access control with a deck watch.
12.1.fg: Gangway watch: visitor log, ID check, laging nandoon.
fc: Laging may gangway watchman; visitors' log; ID check at badges
Nakapaskil ang security level
fx: Kontrol sa pagpasok na may deck watch.

12.2.eg: SSO trained, security training/drills for all crew.
ex: SSO trained and security training for everyone.
12.2.fg: Trained ang SSO, security training/drills para sa lahat ng crew.
fc: SSO certificate; security awareness/designated duties certs ng crew
Security drills bawat 3 buwan, annual exercise
fx: Trained ang SSO at may security training para sa lahat.

12.3.eg: SSAS tested; officers know how it works (not where it is).
ex: Officers know the SSAS and it is tested.
Does not ask where the SSAS is
12.3.fg: Nasubukan ang SSAS; alam ng officers kung paano gumagana (hindi kung nasaan).
fc: SSAS test records; alam ng officers ang function (hindi ang lokasyon)
fx: Alam ng officers ang SSAS at sinusubukan ito.
Hindi itinatanong kung nasaan ang SSAS

12.5.eg: High-risk area: BMP5/MSIO charts, voyage risk assessment.
ex: For high-risk areas: updated charts, publications and voyage risk assessment.
12.5.fg: High-risk area: BMP5/MSIO charts, voyage risk assessment.
fc: Pinakabagong BMP / anti-piracy charts (Q6099 atbp.); VRA ng huling transit
fx: Para sa high-risk areas: updated na charts, publications at voyage risk assessment.

ex: Measures against stowaways in port and before departure.
fc: Stowaway search checklist na may areas at pirma
fx: May hakbang laban sa stowaways sa pantalan at bago umalis.

12.7.eg: Cyber security in the SMS (ISM) and assessment/certification.
ex: Cyber security in the SMS, assessed or certified.
Not in the SMS by the first annual DOC audit
12.7.fg: Cyber security sa SMS (ISM) at assessment/certification.
fc: Cyber risk management sa SMS (MSC.428(98)); class notation/certification kung meron
Crew cyber training records
fx: Cyber security sa SMS, may assessment o certification.
Wala sa SMS hanggang sa unang annual DOC audit

12.8.eg: Control of USB/removable media (antivirus scan, policy).
ex: Control of USB and other removable media.
12.8.fg: Kontrol sa USB/removable media (antivirus scan, policy).
fc: Nakapaskil ang USB policy; may dedicated scanning PC; kontrolado ang USB sa ECDIS
fx: Kontrol sa USB at iba pang removable media.

13.1.eg: Engineering procedures in the SMS, EPL/ShaPoLi OMM if fitted.
ex: Checks them (and EPL/ShaPoLi OMM if fitted)
Every use of the power reserve is recorded and reported
13.1.fg: Engineering procedures sa SMS, EPL/ShaPoLi OMM kung meron.
fc: Engineering manual pinakabagong rev.; EPL/ShaPoLi OMM nasa barko at override records
fx: Bawat paggamit ng power reserve ay naka-record at ini-report

13.2.eg: Engineers' responsibilities posted in the ECR, engineers' manning matrix.
ex: Engineers' duties posted in the ECR and a manning matrix.
13.2.fg: Nakapaskil sa ECR ang responsibilities ng engineers, engineers' manning matrix.
fc: Nakapaskil sa ECR ang watch duties; ER manning matrix
fx: Nakapaskil sa ECR ang tungkulin ng engineers at may manning matrix.

13.3.eg: C/E standing orders & night orders signed.
ex: C/E standing and night orders signed by all.
13.3.fg: May pirma ang C/E standing orders at night orders.
fc: C/E standing orders may pirma ng lahat ng engineers/ETO/ratings
Night order book araw-araw at may countersign
fx: May pirma ng lahat ang standing at night orders ng C/E.

13.4.eg: UMS mode working (if certified) – otherwise a reason.
ex: If the ship has UMS, it runs in UMS.
Not in UMS because of defects or shortages
No finding if there is an operational reason (e.g. narrows)
13.4.fg: Gumagana ang UMS mode (kung certified) – kung hindi, may dahilan.
fc: Ginagamit ang UMS; kung hindi, operational na dahilan (hindi defects!)
fx: Kung may UMS ang barko, naka-UMS ito.
Hindi naka-UMS dahil sa sira o kakulangan
Walang finding kung may operational na dahilan (hal. makitid na daanan)

13.5.eg: If not UMS – enough ER crew.
ex: If not UMS, enough staff in the ER.
13.5.fg: Kung hindi UMS – sapat ang ER crew.
fc: Watch schedule kumpara sa rest hours
fx: Kung hindi UMS, sapat ang tao sa ER.

13.6.eg: UMS entry requirements posted at the ER entrance.
ex: UMS entry rules posted at the ER entrance.
13.6.fg: Nakapaskil sa pasukan ng ER ang UMS entry requirements.
fc: Notice sa pasukan ng ER; dead-man/bridge call
fx: Nakapaskil sa pasukan ng ER ang patakaran sa pagpasok kapag UMS.

13.7.fg: Naka-set at gumagana ang dead man alarm.
fc: Subukan ang dead man alarm
fx: Tama ang set ng dead man alarm.

13.8.eg: Engineers' call alarm tested (the inspector will test it).
ex: Will test it with the Master's agreement
13.8.fg: Nasubukan ang engineers' call alarm (susubukan ito ng inspector).
fc: Subukan mula sa bridge at ECR; records
fx: Susubukan niya kung payag ang Master
ff: Hindi gumagana ang engineers' call alarm sa lahat ng cabin/public spaces

13.9.eg: Engine logbook & alarm records correct, alarm printer at the correct time.
ex: No handwritten alarm log when there is no printer
Checks time and date on the alarm printer
13.9.fg: Tama ang engine logbook at alarm records, tama ang oras ng alarm printer.
fc: Kumpleto ang ER logbook; tama ang oras ng alarm printer/automation
Manual alarm log kung sira ang printer
fx: Walang sulat-kamay na alarm log kapag walang printer
Chine-check ang oras at petsa sa alarm printer

13.10.eg: Blackout recovery procedure posted, preferential trips known.
ex: Blackout recovery procedures posted in the ER.
13.10.fg: Nakapaskil ang blackout recovery procedure, alam ang preferential trips.
fc: Nakapaskil ang blackout recovery sa ECR at em'cy gen; kayang ipaliwanag ng engineers ang preferential trips
fx: Nakapaskil sa ER ang blackout recovery procedures.

13.11.eg: Computer PMS updated, no overdue jobs, synced with office.
13.11.fg: Updated ang computer PMS, walang overdue, naka-sync sa opisina.
fc: Walang overdue jobs (o postponed na may approval ng opisina)
Updated ang running hours; naka-sync ang data sa opisina
Alam ng engineers ang software
ff: Overdue PMS jobs / hindi naka-sync ang PMS sa opisina

13.13.eg: Main engine maintenance per maker (fuel valves, pumps, exhaust valves, units).
ex: Random check of fuel valves, pumps, exhaust valves
13.13.fg: Main engine maintenance ayon sa maker (fuel valves, pumps, exhaust valves, units).
fc: Random check: fuel valves, fuel pumps, exhaust valves, cylinder covers kumpara sa oras ng maker
Scavenge inspection records; ME performance
fx: Naaalagaan ang main engine ayon sa maker.
Random na check ng fuel valves, pumps, exhaust valves

13.14.eg: Auxiliary engine maintenance per maker & idle generators run regularly.
13.14.fg: Auxiliary engine maintenance ayon sa maker at regular na pinapaandar ang idle gens.
fc: Random check ng overhauls kumpara sa oras
Pinaandar kamakailan ang idle generators (logbook)
fx: Naaalagaan ang auxiliary engines ayon sa maker.
Chine-check kung pinaandar kamakailan ang idle generators

13.15.eg: Good ER lighting, escape routes marked & clear.
ex: Good lighting and marked, clear escape routes in the ER.
13.15.fg: Maliwanag ang ER, may marka at malinis ang escape routes.
fc: Gumagana lahat ng ilaw (kasama emergency); may marka (LLL) at walang harang ang escape routes
Gumagana ang pinto ng escape trunk
fx: Maliwanag at may marka at malinis na escape routes sa ER.
ff: Hindi gumagana ang ilaw sa ER, may harang o walang marka ang escape routes

13.17.eg: Emergency equipment tested & recorded (em'cy lights, alarms, batteries).
ex: Asks for an explanation of automatic sequential testing
13.17.fg: Nasubukan at naka-record ang emergency equipment (em'cy lights, alarms, batteries).
fc: Test records; kayang ipaliwanag ang auto sequential testing
fx: Humihingi ng paliwanag sa automatic sequential testing

13.18.eg: Emergency stops of ventilation & fire flaps marked and tested.
ex: Emergency stops of fans and fire flaps marked and tested.
13.18.fg: May marka at nasubukan ang emergency stops ng ventilation at fire flaps.
fc: May marka at nasubukan ang remote stops; sumasara at may marka ang fire flaps
fx: May marka at nasubukan ang emergency stops ng fans at fire flaps.

13.19.eg: Hot surfaces insulated, flanges with spray shields/tape.
ex: Hot surfaces covered and fuel flanges with spray tape or shields.
13.19.fg: May insulation ang mainit na surface, may spray shields/tape ang flanges.
fc: Walang nakalantad na mainit na surface >220°C (i-check ang exhaust, turbocharger, indicator cocks)
Spray tape/shields sa FO/LO flanges malapit sa mainit na surface
fx: Natatakpan ang mainit na surface at may spray tape o shields ang fuel flanges.
ff: Walang insulation ang mainit na surface / walang spray shields sa fuel at LO flanges

ex: Insulation in good condition and free of oil.
13.20.fg: Lagging at insulation na hindi basa ng langis.
fc: Palitan ang lagging na basa ng langis
fx: Maayos at walang langis ang insulation.
